findings.summary: first() is imported but never called on the flow returned by programStateRepo.observe(program.id) (Flow<ProgramState?>). initialState holds the Flow object itself, so initialState == null is always false. startDestination is unconditionally Main on every launch, including a fresh install with no program state; onboarding is unreachable.
